candidates.change_summary: Delete the require(__sent_result100) statement so failures of the external call are no longer reverted.
Delete the transfer to owner so leftover balance stays in the contract instead of being swept to the owner.
Replace the external target with owner so the forwarded value is sent to the owner instead of the fixed address.
Replace the call value msg.value with 0 so no ether is forwarded to the target.
Delete the statement that transfers the remaining balance to the owner.
Delete the require check on the call result so failures are no longer reverted.
Change the call target from the fixed address to the owner.
Move the owner transfer before the external call so the leftover balance is sent prior to forwarding value.
Change the low-level call target to the owner instead of the fixed address.
Remove the require check so a failed low-level call no longer reverts, changing value retention/refund behavior.
Forward the entire contract balance instead of msg.value in the low-level call.
Remove the external call entirely so funds are only forwarded to the owner.
Change the final transfer to send the leftover balance to msg.sender instead of the owner.
Delete the statement transferring the remaining balance to the owner.
Send the leftover balance to msg.sender instead of the owner.
Remove the require check so a failed call to the target no longer reverts.
Forward the msg.value to the owner instead of the fixed target address.
Transfer only msg.value to the owner instead of the contract's full balance, leaving extra funds in the contract.
Remove the require on the call result so failures to the target no longer revert, leaving leftover balance changes observable after go().
Send msg.value instead of the entire remaining balance to the owner, changing how much value is forwarded after the target call.
Remove the require that reverts on failed low-level call, so failures no longer revert the transaction.
Sweep the remaining balance to msg.sender instead of the owner.
Remove the statement that transfers the remaining balance to the owner.
Remove the require check on the call result so failed external calls no longer revert, changing whether the transfer to owner occurs.
Forward the entire contract balance to the target instead of only msg.value, changing the amount sent and leaving nothing for the owner transfer.
Send the remaining balance to the target instead of the owner, changing the recipient of the leftover funds.
Remove the transfer of the remaining balance to the owner.
Remove the require check on the call result so failed calls no longer revert.
Send zero value to the target instead of msg.value, leaving the funds to go to the owner.
Move the transfer to the owner before the call to the target.
